tokens.name: surface
tokens.usage: Page and screen background: buhangin (sand) by day, night sea by night.

tokens.name: surface-raised
tokens.usage: Cards, bottom sheets, the booking bar.

tokens.name: surface-sunk
tokens.usage: Inputs, chip tracks, photo placeholders, map land.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairlines and dividers between rows. Decorative only, never the only edge of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Borders of inputs, chips and quiet buttons. Meets 3:1 on surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunk, dagat-soft and mango.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: distances, timestamps, helper copy. On surface, surface-raised and surface-sunk.

tokens.name: mango
tokens.usage: The primary action fill (Book na, Pin this spot) and the selected chip. Text on it is on-mango.

tokens.name: mango-soft
tokens.usage: Caution backgrounds (weather Mag ingat) and highlighted rows. Text on it is mango-ink.

tokens.name: mango-ink
tokens.usage: Mango as text: prices on sand, caution labels on mango-soft.

tokens.name: on-mango
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a mango fill.

tokens.name: dagat
tokens.usage: The sea: links, secondary actions, the Licensed badge, go weather, followers pins, focus ring. As text on surface, surface-raised, surface-sunk and dagat-soft.

tokens.name: dagat-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted background behind dagat text: Licensed badge, go weather, selected list rows.

tokens.name: on-dagat
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a dagat fill.

tokens.name: lapu
tokens.usage: Kap Lapu's body and hot spot pins (fresh catches). Icons only on it, never text.

tokens.name: lapu-soft
tokens.usage: Mascot belly, hot spot halo, fresh catch tag background.

tokens.name: lapu-ink
tokens.usage: Lapu as text: Fresh catch tag on lapu-soft or surface. Also the mascot's spots and fins.

tokens.name: on-lapu
tokens.usage: Icons on a lapu fill (pin glyphs). Not for text: 3.7:1 in light.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Errors, No go weather, failed verification. Always with an icon and words.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Background behind danger text.

tokens.name: map-water
tokens.usage: Sea fill in the custom Mapbox style.

tokens.name: map-land
tokens.usage: Land fill in the custom Mapbox style.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard and switch focus: a 2px solid ring offset 2px. 3:1 or better on every surface.

tokens.name: mascot-outline
tokens.usage: Kap Lapu's outline and pupils. Stays dark in both themes so he looks the same at night.

tokens.name: mascot-eye
tokens.usage: Kap Lapu's eye whites and cap.

styles.name: display
styles.usage: One per screen at most: onboarding, booking confirmed, empty states.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Screen titles, spot and boat names on their detail screens.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Prices, list row titles, sheet headers.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Malakas ang kagat ng talakitok dito tuwing high tide.
styles.usage: Default reading text. Never smaller for paragraphs.

styles.name: body-strong
styles.sample: Libre ang reschedule pag masama ang panahon.
styles.usage: Emphasis inside body copy and button labels.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Badges, tab labels, small caps of meaning. Sentence case, never all caps.

styles.name: caption
styles.usage: Sources, timestamps, legal footnotes. Not for anything a person must act on.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon to label gap inside badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between chips; tight stacks.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Card inner gaps between rows.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding and the screen gutter on phones.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Sheet padding.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Between sections in a scroll.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Above a screen title; around the mascot in empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Inputs, small thumbnails, tags.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons and list cards.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Feature cards, bottom sheets (top corners), photos.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Chips, badges, the seat counter.

tokens.name: shadow-card
tokens.usage: Cards floating over the map.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Bottom sheets and the sticky booking bar.

tokens.name: tap-min
tokens.usage: Smallest tappable height. Owners often use the app on a moving boat with wet hands.

tokens.name: pin
tokens.usage: Map pin width.
